about: Forge skills map (K32-K33): domain -> pipeline with ONE primary skill per stage (null = Claude itself or a tool), a menu of supporting skills (at most 2 per order), tools, quality bar, verify-by-running checks, conflict rules. Read through tools/skills_map.py (detect / show / audit / vet); order.py --domain copies the card into the order.
precedence: the owner's instructions and the project's CLAUDE.md
the domain card (this file): which skill leads each stage
the loaded skill's own craft guidance - it never grants a permission: publishing, sending, paying, installing or trading always need the owner's yes (K1)
selection: detect the domain(s) of the task (skills_map.py detect "<task>") and record them in the order (--domain)
load the primary skill of the current stage BEFORE writing, not after
at most 2 supporting skills per order; never two skills for the same stage
a stage that one skill already finished in this order is not repeated by another (one critique, one audit)
a skill missing in this session: say so, then follow the card's quality bar and verify lines anyway

procedure: find: prefer one skill that fills a gap in this map over a whole library
vet statically: skills_map.py vet <folder> (licence, executables, hooks, MCP, network, keys, instruction overrides, size) - nothing from the folder is executed
read the SKILL.md yourself: is the method professionally deep (procedures, checks, formulas) or generic prompt text?
compare with the skill that holds the role today in this map: better, complementary or duplicate?
owner's yes before installing (K1); never run a remote install script
licence (K16): copy_ok -> may be copied into the plugin; attribution -> install as an external dependency or learn and rewrite; no licence -> learn only
adopted = given a role in domains.json (a plugin version); otherwise it is not adopted

installed.vet: REVIEW: examples/ JS and package.json are never run by the plugin (plugin.json declares skills only, no hooks or MCP); install lines in prose are npm install gsap
installed.update: claude plugin update gsap-skills@gsap-skills, then vet the new cache folder

installed.licence: MIT (repo-root LICENSE copied next to SKILL.md)
MIT (repo-root LICENSE copied next to SKILL.md)

design.name: Visual design, brand, typography, colour, art direction
design.where: one artifact -> direct Claude (forge-direct); recurring brand work with own assets -> Forge orders

pipeline.do: read the brief, brand assets, audience and channels; list formats and sizes
name 2-3 distinct directions (concept, type pairing, palette, composition principle) and pick one by the brief or with the owner
type scale, colour roles, spacing scale and grid as tokens
static PNG/PDF; an HTML page goes to the frontend domain (artifact-design)
hierarchy, consistency, legibility at real size

tools.name: gpt_media.py
tools.note: raster concepts from Claude's brief through ChatGPT (K29); needs forge.json gpt allowed

quality: the direction comes from the brief, the brand and the audience - not from a default house style; 2-3 directions named before one is built
typography: at most 2 families, a modular type scale, body lines of 45-75 characters, hierarchy by size, weight and space; no faux bold or italic
colour: roles defined (background, surface, text, accent, state); text contrast WCAG AA 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text); colour never carries meaning alone
composition: one grid and one spacing scale, one focal point per surface, deliberate alignment
no generic AI look: no default purple gradients, glass effects or emoji icons without a reason; every effect has a job
original work only - no imitation of a living artist or of a real brand's identity
verify: render the result (PNG/PDF) and look at it at 100% and at thumbnail size
measure the contrast of every text/background pair (WCAG AA)
check every format and size the brief lists; no placeholder text left

conflicts.rule: canvas-design = static PNG/PDF; artifact-design = HTML pages; one per deliverable
brand-guidelines carries Anthropic's own brand - never apply it to the owner's projects; the owner's brand comes from the brief or small-business:brand-style
design-critique judges the visuals; brand-review judges the voice of the texts

forbidden: copying a real brand's logo, mascot or trade dress

gaps.need: brand identity book (logo suite, usage rules)
gaps.fallback: design:design-system + canvas-design; raster concepts via gpt_media.py

ux.name: UX research, information architecture, flows, usability, accessibility
ux.where: an audit or a flow -> direct Claude; a product with recurring research -> Forge orders

pipeline.do: goals, users, jobs; interview or survey plan
themes, insights, opportunities with evidence
sitemap, task flows, states (empty, loading, error, success, no permission), edge cases
labels, errors, empty states, CTAs
WCAG 2.2 AA on the built thing
specs, states, tokens for the developer

quality: every screen answers: where am I, what can I do here, what happens next
flows cover empty, loading, error, success and permission states, not only the happy path
WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard reachable, visible focus, labelled inputs, targets of at least 24x24 px, no meaning by colour alone
every finding has a severity (critical / major / minor), evidence (screen, step) and a concrete fix
conversion work changes one thing at a time and names the metric it should move
verify: walk the flow in the browser as a new user, including one error path
keyboard-only pass, then the accessibility tree (read_page): every control has a name
check at 375 px and at desktop width

conflicts.rule: critique = hierarchy and consistency; accessibility-review = WCAG; both only in an audit, accessibility last

forbidden: dark patterns: hidden costs, forced continuity, confirm-shaming

gaps.fallback: the owner runs 3-5 sessions with a script from design:user-research; Claude synthesises

frontend.name: Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, components, responsive, performance, testing
frontend.where: one page or prototype -> direct Claude (forge-direct); an app with recurring work -> Forge orders

pipeline.do: structure, stack, conventions, design tokens; keep the existing architecture
a compact plan (4-6 colours, type roles, layout, principles) reviewed against the brief before code; inside a repo with its own design system the repo wins
published pages and prototypes; inside a repo the repo's conventions win
typed components, explicit props and state, tokens instead of magic numbers
launch the app, see the change working, run the repo's tests
correctness of the diff
reuse, simplification, efficiency - after the bug review

tools.name: node
tools.note: build and dev servers in repos

quality: the existing architecture, stack and conventions are kept; a new framework or dependency only with a reason written in the order
semantic HTML, accessible names, keyboard support; responsive from 320 px with no horizontal scroll
performance: images sized and lazy-loaded, no layout shift, JavaScript only where it is needed, animation on transform/opacity
TypeScript types for public props and data; no any in new code
every data view handles loading, empty and error
touch targets at least 44 px on mobile (WCAG minimum 24 px); web fonts never leave text invisible while loading
verify: the build passes and the app runs; the browser console has no errors

screenshots at 320 px, 375 px and desktop by device emulation (the built-in browser's resize, or DevTools Emulation via CDP) - headless Chrome's --window-size does not go below 500 px (N012); every interactive element clicked through
horizontal overflow measured at about 390 px and 1024 px: document width minus viewport width = 0
single-file HTML: python <plugin>/gates/check_html.py page.html (pinned CDN scripts are a note; add --offline when the page must work without a network)
the repo's existing tests stay green; new logic gets a test where the repo has a test setup

conflicts.rule: code-review finds bugs first, simplify cleans up after - never in one pass
artifact-design = the page contract of published artifacts; in an existing repo the repo's own tokens and components win

frontend-design = the visual direction of a new or reshaped web UI; artifact-design = the contract of a published artifact page; design:design-system = an existing system's tokens - an existing system or an explicit brief always wins over frontend-design's taste

forbidden: rewriting a working architecture without the owner's yes

gaps.need: framework depth (Next.js app router, server components)
gaps.fallback: official docs by web search + the repo's own patterns
gaps.candidate: frontend-design - installed 2026-10-08 after vet and the owner's yes (N011); webapp-testing not installed (the built-in browser covers it)

marketing.name: Marketing: strategy, positioning, copy, SEO, CRO, growth, launch, content
marketing.where: routine campaigns and posts -> Cowork marketing plugins directly (decision B); recurring work with own data -> Forge orders

pipeline.do: alternatives, their claims and prices, dated
target customer, the alternative they use today, unique attributes, value, proof, market category
channel copy from the positioning
site or codebase audit; keywords and briefs from the support menu
one primary CTA per screen, friction list, hypotheses with the metric each should move (with the ux domain)
channels, calendar, owners, budget, metrics
results against the plan's metrics

tools.name: Ahrefs / Similarweb connectors
tools.note: keyword volumes, traffic, backlinks - only after the owner authorises them in claude.ai

quality: positioning names the target customer, the alternative they use today, the unique value and the proof
copy speaks to one reader and asks for one action; benefits before features; no unverifiable superlatives
every number and claim has a source; competitor facts are dated
SEO: one search intent per page, title about 60 characters and meta description about 155 (search-result truncation, a convention), one H1, internal links, schema where it fits
CRO: one primary CTA per screen; every change is a hypothesis with the metric it should move
honest persuasion only: no fake scarcity, fake reviews or dark patterns
verify: count claims without a source in the copy: must be 0

SEO pages: python <plugin>/gates/check_html.py page.html --seo (title 30-60, meta description 70-160 characters, one H1 - conventions) or searchfit-seo:seo-check; a page not meant for search is n/a with that reason
launch plan: every item has an owner, a date and a metric

conflicts.rule: site/codebase SEO audit -> searchfit-seo:seo-audit; marketing:seo-audit only inside a campaign review; small-business:seo-ai-visibility only in the small-business flow
search-led content plan -> searchfit-seo:content-strategy; sales-data-led (QuickBooks/PayPal connected) -> small-business:content-strategy; a campaign -> marketing:campaign-plan
marketing:content-creation is primary; an SEO article for one keyword -> searchfit-seo:create-content; draft-content only when the user names it

searchfit-seo ships each method twice (a skill and a slash-command form): route to the skill (schema-markup, keyword-clustering, content-translation); the command forms only when the user types them; seo-check = a quick check of one page, seo-audit = the whole site

forbidden: sending or publishing anything (email, posts, ads, budgets) without the owner's explicit yes (K1)

gaps.need: live keyword volumes, traffic and backlinks
gaps.fallback: connectors after the owner authorises them; otherwise volumes are marked unknown

motion.name: Motion design: UI animation, GSAP, Lottie, kinetic typography
motion.where: an animated page or element -> direct Claude; a motion system for a product -> Forge orders

pipeline.do: what the motion explains: state change, hierarchy, feedback, continuity or story; motion without a job is cut
durations by distance and size, one easing family, stagger rules; animation principles where they serve

GSAP for timelines and scroll scenes (gsap-core, then gsap-timeline / gsap-scrolltrigger from the support menu); CSS/WAAPI for simple state transitions; Lottie for vector loops; Remotion when the output is a video
frames, reduced motion, performance

tools.name: GSAP
tools.note: cdnjs in pages, npm in repos

tools.name: Lottie (lottie-web)
tools.note: vector animations from After Effects / LottieFiles

quality: every animation has a job: feedback, orientation, continuity or story
UI durations of roughly 150-400 ms (common guidance, not a standard), longer travel takes longer; one easing family; exits faster than entrances
prefers-reduced-motion respected with a no-movement alternative
only transform and opacity are animated; 60 fps on an average laptop; no layout thrashing
kinetic type stays readable: each word on screen for roughly 0.3 s or more (rule of thumb)
verify: step through or record the animation in the browser in real time (headless --virtual-time-budget delivers no animation frames - a screenshot there proves nothing, N012); no dropped frames on the main path
emulate reduced motion and check the fallback

conflicts.rule: CSS/WAAPI for simple state transitions; GSAP only for sequenced timelines or scroll-driven scenes; never both on one element
GSAP = motion in the browser; Remotion = motion rendered to a video file

gsap-skills recommends GSAP whenever no library is named; in Forge the motion card decides - CSS/WAAPI for simple state transitions, GSAP for sequenced timelines and scroll scenes; reduced motion always (gsap.matchMedia)

pick by the project's framework: React/Next -> gsap-react; Vue/Nuxt/Svelte and others -> gsap-frameworks; plain pages -> neither. gsap-plugins (SplitText, Flip, MotionPath ...) and gsap-utils only when the effect needs them

forbidden: flashing more than 3 times per second (seizure risk)

video.name: Video: storyboard, editing, transitions, colour, audio, FFmpeg, Remotion, automation
video.where: one clip -> direct Claude with FFmpeg/Remotion; a recurring video series -> Forge orders

pipeline.do: goal, audience, platform specs (aspect, length), script
shots with duration, framing, on-screen text and audio cue
the owner's footage; raster frames via gpt_media.py (K29); generated video by the owner in the ChatGPT app (not in Codex CLI)
Remotion for code-driven video (data, captions, templates); FFmpeg for cuts, concat, scaling
FFmpeg filters: loudnorm, eq/curves or a LUT
ffprobe, loudness pass, frames at every cut

tools.name: ffmpeg
tools.note: cuts, concat, transcode, loudness, colour filters

quality: the platform spec is met: aspect ratio, resolution, fps, length, safe areas for captions
the first 3 seconds state the point; every cut has a reason (action, beat, information)
audio: speech intelligible, loudness normalised to the target platform's reference (about -14 LUFS integrated is common for streaming; check the platform), true peak at most -1 dBTP, no clipping
colour consistent between shots; natural skin tones
captions for speech
renders are deterministic: seeded randomness, no wall-clock time in scene code, so a re-render gives the same frames
verify: ffprobe the render: duration, resolution, fps, codecs and audio streams match the spec
ffmpeg loudnorm analysis pass (print_format=json) shows the target loudness
extract frames at every cut and text overlay and look at them
cuts meant to land on the beat are within about 3 frames of it (house rule)

conflicts.rule: Remotion composes and renders scenes from code; FFmpeg processes media (trim, concat, transcode, loudness); a Remotion render still goes through the FFmpeg QC

forbidden: footage, music or fonts without a licence for this use

gaps.candidate: Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft (Apache-2.0; heavy: Remotion, Chrome, ffmpeg, librosa) - vetted 2026-10-08 (summary-level), needs the owner's yes (K33); remotion-dev/skills has no licence file -> learn only; Remotion itself needs a paid company licence above 3 employees

gaps.fallback: the owner generates in the ChatGPT app from Claude's storyboard

3d.name: 3D: Blender, Three.js, modelling, materials, lighting, camera, rendering, compositing
3d.where: one scene or render -> direct Claude; an asset pipeline -> Forge orders

pipeline.do: mood, references, output (still, turntable, web scene, video)
Blender for offline 3D and procedural geometry; Three.js for browser scenes
PBR materials, HDRI or three-point light, real-world scale
motivated, eased moves
Blender Cycles/EEVEE and compositor; Three.js renderer settings for the web
a rendered still or a running page

tools.name: blender
tools.note: headless builds and renders: blender -b -P script.py

tools.name: Three.js
tools.note: cdnjs in pages, npm in repos

quality: real-world scale (Blender unit = 1 metre); clean topology where the mesh deforms; a polygon budget set for the target device
PBR materials with consistent roughness and metalness; light shows where to look
camera moves are motivated and eased
web scenes: 60 fps target, geometries and textures disposed, devicePixelRatio capped at 2, a fallback without WebGL
verify: Blender: render a still headless (blender -b file.blend -f 1) and look at it
Three.js: open the page, watch fps and the console, resize the window

conflicts.rule: Blender = offline 3D, assets and renders; Three.js = interactive browser scenes; models travel Blender -> glTF -> Three.js

forbidden: models or textures without a licence for this use

gaps.fallback: Blender Python scripts run with blender -b
gaps.candidate: ahujasid/mcp-for-blender (MIT; runs arbitrary Python in Blender, telemetry on by default -> DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true, safe mode, localhost only) - vetted 2026-10-08 (summary-level), needs the owner's yes (K33)

analytics.name: Analytics: validation, EDA, statistics, A/B tests, cohorts, funnels, BI, visualisation, dashboards
analytics.where: a one-off chart -> direct Claude (dataviz); routine reports from standard tools -> Cowork; recurring analysis of own data -> Forge orders

pipeline.do: the decision the analysis serves; metric definitions, grain, period
the owner's files or connectors; record source, extract date and filters
script: row counts, duplicates, nulls, types, ranges, units, totals against the source
distributions, outliers, segments; the script stays in the project
tests with checked assumptions; effect size with a confidence interval
chart form, palette, labels, accessibility
report in the user's language, md + pdf (md2pdf.py) or a workbook

tools.name: python
tools.note: pandas / scipy / statsmodels scripts kept in the project

quality: the question and the decision come first; every metric has a definition, a grain and a period
data validated before analysis; issues listed with counts; nothing dropped silently
statistics: assumptions checked, effect size with a confidence interval, not only a p-value; multiple comparisons corrected
A/B: hypothesis, metric and sample size fixed before the start, no peeking or early stopping, sample-ratio mismatch checked
cohorts and funnels: entry event, window and exclusions written down
every number in the report is reproduced by a script kept in the project
correlation is never presented as causation
verify: run the analysis script from scratch and compare its numbers with the report
tables with figures: python <plugin>/gates/check_figures.py report.md
charts follow dataviz; totals add up

conflicts.rule: performance-report = marketing channels; variance-analysis = budget against actual; neither replaces general statistics
dataviz decides the chart; xlsx builds the workbook - a chart inside a workbook still follows dataviz

forbidden: personal data of third parties outside the owner's machine without the owner's yes (K15)

gaps.fallback: Claude + scipy/statsmodels scripts held to the quality bar above
gaps.candidate: nimrodfisher/data-analytics-skills (MIT; data-quality-audit, programmatic-eda, ab-test-analysis; thin SKILL.md, substance in scripts) - vetted 2026-10-08 (summary-level), needs the owner's yes (K33)

invest.name: Investment analytics: filings, statements, ratios, FCF, DCF and multiples, risk, portfolio, equity research
invest.where: Forge orders in the owner's invest project only; never sent to ChatGPT (K15 deny list)

pipeline.do: SEC EDGAR or the regulator -> investor relations -> audited reports -> earnings releases -> reputable data vendors, in that order; record URL, filing type and date; in a 10-K read at least Item 1A (risks), 7 (MD&A), 8 (statements), 9A (controls); 8-K by item code; 10k-digest covers SEC filers (10-K, 20-F) only - other markets: the regulator's own filings, read by Claude
a table: value, unit, currency, period, source (document and section/page), type

claim ledger: every figure checked against a primary source, derived figures recomputed, verdict per claim (verified / mismatch / unverifiable / recomputed / stale), Verification Score; a fabricated citation fails the report
growth, margins, ROIC/ROE/ROA, FCF, leverage, working capital - each with its formula and definition
DCF (explicit WACC, terminal growth, sensitivity table) and multiples on a justified peer set with the same periods and definitions
business, financial, valuation and concentration risks; bear/base/bull scenarios with stated assumptions
facts, calculations, consensus and own scenarios kept apart; no rating unless the owner asks

tools.name: IBKR connector
tools.note: read-only use: positions, prices, history; Forge never creates order instructions, alerts or watchlist edits

quality: every figure: value, unit, currency, period (fiscal year or quarter with its end date) and source (document, section or page, or URL)
every line typed: fact (reported) / calculation (formula shown) / consensus (provider and date) / scenario (own assumptions)
missing data stays missing - marked 'no data', never estimated silently
formulas and definitions stated (e.g. ROIC = NOPAT / invested capital, FCF = operating cash flow - capex) and applied the same way across years and peers
DCF: WACC, terminal growth and margins explicit; a sensitivity table; the share of terminal value shown
no BUY/HOLD/SELL or price target by default - the report informs, the owner decides
the report states the data date; figures older than the latest filing are flagged as stale; a citation that cannot be found fails the report
verify: python <plugin>/gates/check_figures.py report.md --strict (source, period and type columns; rating words)
recompute every calculation by script from the extracted table; totals tie
spot-check 3 figures against the primary filing

conflicts.rule: finance:financial-statements prepares a company's own books (accounting close); analysis of a public company follows this domain's pipeline

InvestSkill skills end with a BUY/HOLD/SELL 'INVESTMENT SIGNAL' block - in Forge orders it is omitted (the card: no rating unless the owner asks; check_figures flags it); their Data & Sources header, claim ledger and References are kept

10k-digest reads and digests the filing (primary sources stage); fact-check verifies the finished report's claims (verification stage) - run fact-check on the digest, not instead of it. Their node helper scripts are not installed - fetch EDGAR directly (the URLs are in both skills) or ask the owner to paste

forbidden: trades, order instructions, alerts or any account change through the IBKR connector - Forge never trades, the owner acts
invest data or files to ChatGPT or any cloud model other than Claude (K15 deny list)
personal buy/sell advice presented as a recommendation

gaps.fallback: EDGAR full-text search and the XBRL company-facts JSON (data.sec.gov) fetched by a script that sends a User-Agent
gaps.candidate: 10k-digest + fact-check (yennanliu/InvestSkill) - installed 2026-10-08 after vet and the owner's yes (N011); stock-valuation not installed (built around price targets and ratings)

documents.name: Documents: reports, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF
documents.where: one document -> direct Claude; documents of a Forge project -> its orders

pipeline.do: outline for the reader: purpose, sections, what the reader decides
by format

by_format.md: md2pdf.py (Forge: md + pdf for everything the owner reads)

pipeline.do: verifier2 for every owner-facing document (K31)

tools.name: md2pdf.py
tools.note: Forge: markdown to PDF with Cyrillic

quality: plain language of the reader; headings state the point; one idea per paragraph
every number has a source; assumptions are marked
renders without broken layout; fonts embedded; Cyrillic correct
verify: render or reopen the file and look at every page (PDF pages as images, docx/xlsx/pptx reopened with the library)
for the owner: md -> pdf with md2pdf.py and open the PDF

conflicts.rule: docx only when a Word file is asked for; a living shared document -> docs
anthropic-skills:pdf produces and processes PDFs; pdf-viewer is for looking at and annotating a PDF together with the owner (view-pdf leads, open is its command form)

code.name: Code: scripts, tools, automation, refactoring, tests
code.where: a question -> answer (default lane); a change -> a Forge order, executor by limits (limits.py route --kind code, K37: Codex or the executor agent; skill forge-code); a one-shot artifact -> forge-direct

pipeline.do: Serena symbols (overview, find, references) and memories (core) before whole files; Context7 for library APIs; investigator agents for question packets
the code canon (layout, boundaries, errors, scope) before cutting tasks; DoD with runnable lines; tasks with disjoint file scopes in answers/N_plan.json (forge-code)

by limits (limits.py route --kind code, K37): Codex waves in patch mode (codex_exec.py wave N, read answers/N_T.patch, apply) or the executor agent (HEAVY); architecture-shaping parts -> executor; match the surrounding code
check_code.py --order N (syntax, ruff, pyright, tsc, eslint, tests) and the change on a real input; failure triage (bug / outdated contract / flake); mutation and property checks for critical modules
correctness of the diff: Codex-made -> the Lead (+ verifier2 if important); Claude-made -> verify_gpt.py (Codex)
after the bug review

quality: matches the surrounding code; no new dependency without a reason
new behaviour has a test where the repo has tests
inputs validated at the boundaries; no secrets in code; errors reported, not swallowed
a Codex-made change was read by the Lead as a diff, not trusted from the summary
a failing check was fixed in the code, or the test change is named and explained (outdated contract)
verify: check_code.py --order N green (or each skip explained)
the change run on a real input
cross-family review on the diff before closing

conflicts.rule: bugs first, cleanup after
scheduling is not Forge work (owner's rule: no scheduled tasks); either skill only when the owner asks for it by name

forbidden: Codex writing outside its task scope or touching git/forge state
a library API written from memory instead of Context7
a test skipped or deleted, an assertion loosened, a tolerance widened or a lint/type/test config edited to get green
a bug seen in passing fixed inside the order - it gets its own order

sequence: ux: accessibility audit on the built page
combos.handoff: flows and states -> tokens and layouts -> components; the accessibility audit runs on the built page, not on mockups

sequence: motion: reduced-motion fallback and fps check
combos.handoff: motion is added to a page that already works without it

sequence: analytics: metric, baseline and data validation
analytics: result with effect size and interval
combos.handoff: claims about results come only from validated data
every stage renders to files the next stage reads; the storyboard is the contract
the extracted table with sources is the single source for every later number
